VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next‑generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry‑first model which brings together the best of in‑house and 3rd party capability.
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

## About this role

We are seeking a detail‑oriented and analytically strong individual to support financial planning, analysis, and performance management across regional teams. The role enables effective commercial decision‑making, delivers financial insight at customer level, improves forecasting accuracy, and strengthens financial processes by closely partnering with finance business partners, sales teams, and commercial stakeholders.

## What you'll do

Collaborate with finance business partners and sales leaders to deliver accurate month‑end results and reporting packs.
Provide insightful commentary on budgets and forecasts, explaining drivers of performance at customer level.
Translate complex financial and commercial data into clear insights for business leads and guide sales teams on commitments required to meet targets.
Deliver baseline forecasting and work closely with commercial, contract accounting, and sales teams to ensure robust assumptions.
Support annual sales targeting across revenue, new business, and renewals, advising on assumptions, risks, opportunities, and performance gaps.
Understand cost‑of‑sales structures and contribute to efficiency and improvement initiatives through cross‑functional collaboration.

## Who you are

Experienced in working within complex, multi‑functional corporate environments.
Intellectually curious, able to challenge established approaches and suggest new ways of working.
Skilled at simplifying complex information for diverse stakeholders, including non‑financial audiences.
Proactive and experienced in driving change and delivering improvement projects.
Strong in problem‑solving, financial modelling, analysis, and high‑attention to detail.
Professionally qualified (CA, CMA, CPA, MBA or equivalent) or possessing deep practical expertise in financial and commercial analysis.
Proficient in Excel and SAP, with strong communication skills across written and verbal formats.

## Not a perfect fit

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

## What's in for you

Opportunities to collaborate with diverse regional teams and senior stakeholders.
Exposure to strategic and commercial aspects of financial planning and reporting.
Experience in driving improvements in forecasting, cost management, and decision‑making processes.
Development in stakeholder management, cross‑functional collaboration, and financial storytelling.

## What skill you will learn

Advanced financial modelling and analytical techniques.
Effective business partnering with commercial and sales teams.
Improved forecasting, budgeting, and planning capabilities.
Skills in translating financial data into actionable business insights.
Techniques for driving operational efficiencies and improvement initiatives.

## VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment

Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background

## Join US

At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
With us, you can be truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

Position: Manager – GL Close/FP&A/Investment Accounting/Reg Reporting/Financial Accounting

Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Manager with 8-10 years of progressive accounting and financial planning experience to lead financial operations and financial transformation projects. The successful candidate will oversee general ledger close processes, month-end accounting operations, investment accounting, and financial planning activities. The Manager will lead finance transformation initiatives focused on General Ledger (GL) Close, FP&A, and Record to Report operations within Financial Services firms. This role requires a strategic manager with extensive process expertise and proficiency in technology platforms (e.g., Oracle, Workday, Adaptive, PowerApps) to drive significant value. • Chart of Accounts Mapping & Redesign: Design, implement, optimize Chart of Accounts structures that align with reporting requirements. Lead CoA mapping during ERP implementations, ensuring seamless data translation. Develop dimensional hierarchies and account coding standards to support multi-entity consolidation and reporting.
• Management of GL Close Activities: Lead and manage the complete GL close and month-end accounting cycles, ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant financial statement preparation. Review journal entries, reconciliation procedures and account analyses to ensure financial statement integrity. Coordinate inter-company eliminations, consolidation adjustments and balance sheet reconciliations.
• Investment Accounting Operations Oversee investment accounting operations, including security transactions, valuations, reconciliations, and reporting. Prepare investment performance reports, reconcile investment holdings and manage regulatory compliance for investment portfolios.

• Technology Transformation: Establish automated close processes and eliminate legacy systems through process redesign. Implement advanced accounting platforms viz. Workday, Workiva, Blackline, Tagetik, Trintech and spearhead finance transformation initiatives.

Key Skills:

• GL Close: General Ledger Management, Chart of Accounts Design and Month end close processes

• Finance Transformation: Proven experience in conducting As-Is and To-Be process assessments, process redesign and continuous improvement methodologies.
• Finance Systems Proficiency: Significant experience with Finance Systems such as Oracle EPM, Anaplan, Adaptive, Workiva, Workday, Blackline, Trintech, Tagetik and designing operating models that integrate people, processes, and technology.
• Stakeholder Engagement: Demonstrated experience in stakeholder engagement, facilitating workshops, and translating complex business needs into actionable solutions.

Education:

• Domain Expertise: Strong exposure to working in the Financial Services domain across Banking, Insurance, Asset Management, and Capital Markets.
• Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or Business Administration. Advanced degrees (MBA or equivalent) are preferred. B.Tech or Engineering graduates with relevant work experience in finance or financial systems.

Experience Requirements:

• Extensive Experience: 10+ years of experience in finance operations, accounting, or transformation roles.
• Proven Track Record: A successful history of driving finance process improvements, optimizing close cycles, implementing automation, and ensuring compliance in GL Close, FP&A, and R2R functions.
